name: Emilia Carmine
source:
Emilia Carmine is the Ultimate Pyrotechnician but prefers to be called the Ultimate Arsonist. She is a bubbly but stubborn, hot-headed and sarcastic young lady.

She's a master of pyrotechnics and knows all the mechanics and science behind fire. She's not very respectful of personal boundaries and often accidentally makes jokes at others' expense... usually to make herself feel better. She's got a bit of a height complex and gets really mad very easily when people call her a little girl. Leading on from this, Emilia is quick to defend someone if anyone makes fun of the way they look and she does not condone nor tolerate bullying... unless it's done by her.

[From [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/CYcRCAjtxQ0/]official description[/url]]
